title: The Woman of Tekoa and the Return of Absalom
description: Joab sends a wise woman from Tekoa to King David with a fabricated story about two sons and brother-slaying, to persuade David to bring back his son Absalom, who had fled after killing Amnon. The king sees through Joab's plan but relents and allows Absalom to return to Jerusalem. However, Absalom is not permitted to see the king's face for two years. Finally, he sets fire to Joab's field to force him to intercede, and the king summons Absalom and kisses him.
